purpose: Define deterministic allow/deny evaluation from caller identity, group memberships, resource/operation target, assurance requirements and explicit policy rules.

topics.name: AccessCore Rights Evaluation
topics.purpose: Define deterministic allow/deny evaluation from caller identity, group memberships, resource/operation target, assurance requirements and explicit policy rules.

semantics.default_rule: Missing explicit permission fails closed unless an owning policy explicitly defines another safe default.
semantics.assurance_rule: Insufficient assurance produces reauth_required/deny according to resource policy; assurance never grants rights itself.
semantics.group_rule: Group rights contribute only through explicit membership/policy.
semantics.conflict_rule: Conflicting rules resolve through explicit precedence semantics rather than file/order heuristics.
semantics.ui_rule: UI enable/disable state is a projection of the decision, not the enforcement mechanism.

invariants.rule: AccessCore decisions are explicit policy evaluations over identity, resource and operation context; authentication assurance, visibility and ownership never silently become authorization.

hard_gates.condition: missing permission defaults to allow without explicit policy
decision precedence inferred from file/array order
UI state used as sole enforcement

references.purpose: Assurance is an evaluation input, not authorization.
